items.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon frontier model
items.summary: Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier model specialized in long-horizon engineering and state-of-the-art cybersecurity defense, now available to developers, enterprises and consumers. It joins Gemini 4 Argon for complex coding and financial workflows in Google's expanding frontier lineup.

items.headline: Google debuts two specialized AI chips to broaden hardware portfolio
items.summary: Google launched new AI accelerators including the TPU 8i Max, which combines two inference-focused TPU 8i chips to double memory, processing power and bandwidth. The move comes as hyperscalers and AI labs build custom silicon to reduce reliance on Nvidia.

items.headline: Google ships November Pixel Drop with Gemini Intelligence
items.summary: Google's November Pixel Drop brings Gemini Intelligence updates, custom widgets, and the launch of Pixel Tag across its devices. The update extends Google's on-device AI capabilities to the Pixel 10 lineup.

items.headline: Anthropic unveils Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models
items.summary: Anthropic released two new frontier models, with Fable 5.2 broadly available and Mythos 5.2 reserved for vetted cybersecurity and life sciences teams. The launch pairs record-high benchmarks with a 20% API cost reduction and marks Anthropic's first frontier release since CEO Dario Amodei called to slow AI development in September.

items.headline: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI Codex to ship 20x more software
items.summary: CodeRabbit scaled agentic software development using OpenAI models and Codex to govern AI-generated code, shipping 20 times more software with the same engineering team. The case study highlights the enterprise impact of agentic coding tools.
